english.title: Bring an animal / animal product into England other than through a border control post / designated point of entry

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: trade in animals and related products regulations 2011

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) brought

(A)_[an animal, namely **(..SPECIFY ANIMAL..),]_
(B)_[a product specified in Commission Decision 2007/275/EC, namely **(..SPECIFY PRODUCT..),]_

into England other than through a border control post or a point of entry for which a border control post had been designated for that

(C)_[animal]_
(D)_[product]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 13, 39 and 42(2) of the Trade in Animals and Related Products Regulations 2011.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
brought an animal / product specified in Commission Decision 2007/275/EC into England other than hrough a border control post or a point of entry for which a border control post was designated for that animal / product

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: This offence became a summary only offence from 14th December 2019; this offence wording applies for an offence committed on or after 10th February 2025. For an offence committed on or before 13th December 2019 (when this was an either way offence), see offence wording document H18114.
